**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retain sweep records when benchmark runs fail**

For a sweep-on benchmark whose model request throws after being issued, this catch emits only `BenchmarkRunFailure` and never writes the required `sweep_pass_record` with `not_determined` outcomes; if recall completed and a later precision request throws, it also discards the already-established recall classification. Thus terminally failed benchmark passes lose the per-category log evidence required for every category they reached. Track request/classification state here as the review-pass path does and emit the appropriate record before returning the failure.
